audit.why: Even assassin duel (53.07% over 4643 games): Sylas owns 1-3, 4-5 even as W stun arrives, Ekko peaks at first item with Chronobreak, Sylas retakes at two items by bursting below the rewind. Content layer states this correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart blanket 'Skill' on all rows while packet and content agree on Sylas/Sylas/Sylas/Skill/Skill/Ekko/Sylas.
audit.why: Ekko needs W-stun or Phase Dive setup to threaten; pre-4 Sylas simply out-bursts him. First item plus a live Chronobreak is Ekko's window; two items later Sylas bursts below the rewind.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-2 to Sylas, row 5 to Ekko, row 6 to Sylas with rewritten whys and ratings; rows 3-4 correctly stay Skill. Content agrees — side-only edits.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits; two bullets were tradeGood/tradeBad pastes; the Phase Dive auto-reset tell and the anti-heal-vs-Chronobreak-heal interaction (both flagged missing) were unstated in the full layer.
audit.why: Chronobreak is 110/80/50 with untargetability and a percentage heal — Grievous Wounds shrinks it; W is 22s early and only stuns if he enters the anomaly; E and Q both 9s; E is an auto-attack reset whose wind-up is the step-back cue.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns written in with the Hijack 80s comparison; bleed bullets replaced with the auto-reset tell and shield-timing facts; anti-heal folded into breakdown.late.

edits.before: Q-poke the wave contacts — the chain detonation chips while you wait for the real kit at 3.
edits.after: Ekko needs setup to hurt you at 1 — your Chain Lash pokes freely while he farms with autos.

edits.before: W joins: the heal-strike makes even trades dishonest — yours refunds, his doesn't.
edits.after: At 2 the Abscond-Chain Lash trade out-bursts his fragile frame before he can space you.

edits.before: Full kit: E2-chain into Q-W with passive whirls is the lane's best level-3 all-in nobody respects yet.
edits.after: Full kit: E-Q-W kills him before Timewinder kites you — punish every mistimed Phase Dive with Abduct.

edits.before: First item spike: full chains with a stolen ult delete or out-brawl anything mid offers.
edits.after: First item plus Chronobreak is his dive window — do not solo him while the rewind is up.

edits.before: Late Sylas shops the enemy team: steal the fight-flipper, flank with it, and heal through the refund policy.
edits.after: Two items on, your front-loaded burst drops him below what Chronobreak rewinds to — and a stolen R heals you.

edits.before: - Ekko Chronobreak: matchup-defining — Erases your kill and bursts back — track the hologram and save final damage for after it. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Abscond (shield-dash) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Ekko Chronobreak (R): 110s at rank 1, 50s max — it rewinds and heals; save final damage for after it, and note your Hijack is 80s. - Parallel Convergence is 22s early: once the anomaly whiffs, his stun is gone for a long trade. - Phase Dive and Timewinder both sit at 9s.

edits.before: E-shield in, E2-chain, Q-W with whirls between, heal out — the full brawl string he answered with one rotation and regret.
edits.after: His combo opens with Phase Dive's auto-reset wind-up — step back on the roll itself, then chain him once the 9s dash is spent.

edits.before: Chaining into a loaded CC with W down — Sylas without the heal is a mage who chose melee for the aesthetic.
edits.after: Abscond's shield must eat the Phase Dive empowered auto — held for later, his opener lands whole and the trade starts uphill.

edits.before: Ekko wins by landing Chronobreak, denying your pattern, and turning your every misstep into the all-in you hadn’t budgeted.
edits.after: Ekko wins by landing the Parallel Convergence stun, bursting off Phase Dive, and rewinding your answer with Chronobreak.

edits.before: Ahead, monopolize: brawl Ekko off every contact, steal the map's best button on cooldown, and flank fights with their own game plan.
edits.after: Ahead, keep fights short: Ekko needs W-stun resets and a live Chronobreak — force trades in the 110s rewind downtime and snowball.

edits.before: You are whatever the enemy drafted best: steal the fight-flipper, flank with chains, and let W make their focus-fire a rounding error.
edits.after: Late, burst him below the rewind: Abduct-Chain Lash-Kingslayer beats Chronobreak's heal, and Grievous Wounds cuts what is left.
